# GH Archive star-capture quality

Daily WatchEvent and total event counts from the public BigQuery dataset (`githubarchive.day.20*`, `type` column only, 53.8 GB billed), 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-11. Ratios compare each day with the median of the same weekday in 2024. Trusted era ends 2025-05-23.

![capture quality](figures/capture_quality.png)

## Where the stream degrades

- first 14-day run with `stars vs 2024 same-weekday median` < 80%: **2025-05-24**
- first 14-day run with `stars vs 2024 same-weekday median` < 50%: **2026-03-15**
- first 14-day run with `stars vs 2024 same-weekday median` < 20%: **2026-05-25**
- first 14-day run with `stars per IssuesEvent vs 2024` < 80%: **2025-08-05**
- first 14-day run with `stars per IssuesEvent vs 2024` < 50%: **2025-10-09**
- first 14-day run with `stars per IssuesEvent vs 2024` < 20%: **2026-09-23**
